canonical_recovery.map: faithful-state Petz map fixed before data
canonical_recovery.optimization: No rotated-Petz, variational, or best-of recovery search is allowed in the primary score.
canonical_recovery.support_rule: No pseudoinverse threshold may be tuned. Full-rank/faithfulness is required on the scored stratum; otherwise the level is CONDITIONING_FAIL.

conditioning_gates.cmi: I_h >= 0 up to numerical tolerance; negative numerical values are clipped only for display, never for exponent scoring
conditioning_gates.gamma: gamma_h > 0 at every scored level; beta is measured rather than assumed
conditioning_gates.mu: mu_h > 0 at every scored level and no decreasing-to-zero claim may be hidden by clipping
conditioning_gates.state_identity: all state/source/restriction hashes frozen before score calculation

direct_telemetry_score.purpose: Independent cross-check that bypasses looseness in the information-theoretic constants.

conservative_summary.alpha_min: minimum adjacent CMI exponent, with global alpha also reported
conservative_summary.beta_max: maximum adjacent gamma exponent (worst polar-gap closing rate), with global beta reported

exponent_estimator.definition: For positive telemetry y_h, adjacent exponent p_r = log(y_(h/2)/y_h)/log((h/2)/h); global exponent is ordinary least-squares slope of log y vs log h.
exponent_estimator.zero_floor_rule: Numerical underflow/floor hits do not become infinite exponents. Exact zero is admissible only if established analytically or by exact algebraic identity across the family; otherwise exponent score is INCONCLUSIVE.

governance.blind_rule: All geometry, recovery, source, telemetry, exponent, and scoring rules are frozen before any refinement telemetry is generated.
governance.hard_stop: If any required preexisting object is absent, v13.21 freezes the protocol and execution is BLOCKED rather than inventing a continuation.
required_preexisting_objects: a genuine nested family of retained quantum states rho_h describing the same physical relational configuration
an ancestry/coarse-graining map fixed independently of v13.20 outcomes
a source continuation rule fixed independently of RATS scores
a restriction/coarse identification for the target edge/patch

jet_rule.finite_difference_fallback: Allowed only if frozen before telemetry: symmetric central difference with fixed dimensionless step schedule and Richardson consistency check. Failed Richardson consistency is JET_NUMERICS_FAIL, never retuned.
jet_rule.primary: Use the analytic/Frechet ETL and polar/BKM differentials already defined by QMAR.

nested_family_contract.ancestry: Every fine retained degree of freedom used by the target patch must carry a declared parent under the frozen coarse map.
raw_archive: rho_ABC or an exact sufficient representation from which all required marginals are reproducible
nested_family_contract.same_physical_configuration: The refined state must be a continuation/refinement of one fixed relational configuration, not independent random states at each h.
nested_family_contract.scales: h_r = h_0 / 2^r for r=0,...,R-1 with R>=4

target_patch.A_and_C: the two complementary retained regions on the declared separator cut, propagated by ancestry without relabeling after scoring
target_patch.separator_B: the minimal frozen separator subalgebra containing the target edge variables needed to compute rho_i, rho_j, and rho_ij

object: RATS — Recoverability Atlas Telemetry Scaling / Blind Refinement Protocol

source_contract.normalization: The source family and its physical normalization are fixed by the nested generator before scoring.
source_contract.same_source: The true and recovered states receive exactly the same P_h at each h.
source_contract.source_norm_telemetry: p_h = ||P_h||_op is recorded at every level.

telemetry.eta_h: ||dot O_true(h)-dot O_rec(h)||_F under the same source P_h
telemetry.gamma_h: minimum singular value of the target connected-correlation matrices needed by the true/recovered polar maps; score uses the smaller true/recovered floor
telemetry.mu_h: minimum eigenvalue over all true/recovered local density matrices entering BKM/recovery conditioning
required_auxiliary: holonomy/value error on predeclared local loop if present
QMAR-jet holonomy error on that same loop if present

v13_20_information_score.claim_boundary: Finite-level exponent compatibility is evidence for the derived asymptotic condition, not proof of an asymptotic law.
